The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionError messages indicating that cells H46 through L47 contained '#NAME?' instead of the expected numeric values. This error typically occurs when a formula uses an unrecognized function name or an invalid named range. While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistics calculations in the 'Task' worksheet are broken and require formula verification.
